title: Casa Kayok
subtitle: The elegance of a minimalist retreat bathed in tropical light
description:
Located in the prestigious Phase 4 of Puerto Aventuras, this villa sits directly on the canal-front within the most exclusive nautical communities of the Riviera Maya. 
Casa Ka'Yok' is a two-level luxury residence that masterfully embodies contemporary Mediterranean style. The architecture is centered around a spectacular double-height circular foyer featuring a grand dual staircase, designed to harmonize seamlessly with its coastal surroundings. Every space prioritizes fluid movement and the use of noble materials, creating an atmosphere of prestige and absolute serenity.

The ground floor serves as the social heart of the villa, integrating the living room, dining area, and a fully equipped kitchen into an open-concept layout defined by elegant arches. This design promotes natural cross-ventilation and allows an abundance of light to fill the home. For optimal functionality, this level hosts the primary suite with a walk-in closet, as well as a private office and service quarters, both thoughtfully designed with lock-off capability to ensure total privacy.

The upper level opens into four additional secondary suites, each featuring a private bathroom and a walk-in closet. Interior bridges overlook the central foyer, reinforcing the sense of transparency and architectural volume. Crowning the villa is a rooftop patio that offers panoramic views of the water, providing a unique space for contemplation under the Caribbean sky. Every transition between floors is designed to maintain the home’s signature openness and connection to the landscape.

The outdoor experience is centered on the waterfront, featuring a 49 ft infinity pool that creates a perfect visual continuity with the horizon. The property includes a private 49 ft dock, ideal for yachting enthusiasts, complemented by integrated landscaping and spacious terraces. With its interior marble flooring, solid wood finishes, and an underground technical bunker for seamless operations, Casa Ka'Yok' represents the pinnacle of friction-less luxury living by the canal.
highlights: Contemporary Mediterranean architecture on two levels
49 ft private dock and canal-front location
49 ft infinity pool with visual horizon continuity
Grand double-height circular foyer with dual staircase
6 bedrooms including a master suite on the ground floor
Private office and service quarters with lock-off capability
Rooftop patio with panoramic canal views
Fully equipped kitchen with open-concept layout
High-quality finishes including interior marble and solid wood
Underground technical bunker for pool systems
